description: Read delivery statistics for one endpoint — counts of success, pending, sending and fail. The fastest way to see whether an endpoint is healthy. Svix REST: GET /api/v1/app/{app_id}/endpoint/{endpoint_id}/stats.

app_id.description: The application's Svix id or uid.

endpoint_id.description: The endpoint's Svix id or uid.

since.description: ISO-8601 start of the window, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z.

name: svix_get_endpoint_stats
title: Get endpoint delivery stats
